description: Check a transaction already submitted by the payer on the checkout network. Never sends funds. Use the rail and checkoutId returned by request_checkout.

checkoutId.description: Checkout ID returned by request_checkout for the transaction being verified.

rail.description: Exact payment rail selected for this checkout.

txHash.description: Existing transaction hash submitted by the payer; this tool never creates or sends a transaction.
